newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday June 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday June 9.

text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* Democratic Party of the Left harshly criticised deputy prime minister Walter Veltroni for suggesting calling off one of the main results of a parliamentary commission aimed at carrying out constitutional reforms. The commission voted last week in favour of a semi-presidential system (all).
* Hard left Communist Refoundation leader Fausto Bertinotti said the country's welfare state had to be reformed but changes should not include a cut to overall pension spending (all).

* Kenneth Lay, chairman of U.S. group Enron Corp. that last week formed an electricity generating joint venture with Italian utility Enel, said in an interview that the American group's experience would help reduce energy production and distribution costs (La Repubblica).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
